title: Purchase Order
description: Purchase Order contract normalized from the DocuBricks Manufacturing library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-manufacturing-purchase-order
  title: Purchase Order
  description: Purchase Order contract normalized from the DocuBricks Manufacturing library.
  version: manufacturing_purchase_order_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: manufacturing/purchase_order
    sourcePath: Schemas/manufacturing/purchase_order
    sourceVersion: manufacturing_purchase_order_v1
    sourceDigest: 05c9181fb9b669492c420f15ad673ffd564b3a08e22892febb69c13e732cfb63
spec:
  documentType: purchase_order
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - incoterms
        - payment-terms
        - po-date
        - requested-delivery-date
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - currency
        - purchase-order-number
    - id: financials
      title: Financials
      description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - subtotal-amount
        - tax-amount
        - total-amount
    - id: line-items
      title: Line Items
      description: Line Items fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - line-items
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - buyer-contact-name
        - buyer-name
        - supplier-name
    - id: property-or-asset
      title: Property Or Asset
      description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - ship-to-location
    - id: risk-and-compliance
      title: Risk And Compliance
      description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - approval-status
  fields:
    - id: purchase-order-number
      name: purchase_order_number
      label: Purchase Order Number
      description: Purchase order number.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/purchase_order_number
    - id: po-date
      name: po_date
      label: Po Date
      description: Date the purchase order was issued.
      dataType: date
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/po_date
    - id: buyer-name
      name: buyer_name
      label: Buyer Name
      description: Buying legal entity or plant.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/buyer_name
    - id: supplier-name
      name: supplier_name
      label: Supplier Name
      description: Supplier or vendor name.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/supplier_name
    - id: ship-to-location
      name: ship_to_location
      label: Ship To Location
      description: Ship-to plant, warehouse, or address.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/ship_to_location
    - id: requested-delivery-date
      name: requested_delivery_date
      label: Requested Delivery Date
      description: Requested delivery date.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/requested_delivery_date
    - id: currency
      name: currency
      label: Currency
      description: Currency code.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/currency
    - id: payment-terms
      name: payment_terms
      label: Payment Terms
      description: Payment terms.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/payment_terms
    - id: incoterms
      name: incoterms
      label: Incoterms
      description: Incoterms or freight terms.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/incoterms
    - id: line-items
      name: line_items
      label: Line Items
      description: PO line items with part, description, quantity, unit price, and due date.
      dataType: array
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/line_items
    - id: subtotal-amount
      name: subtotal_amount
      label: Subtotal Amount
      description: Subtotal amount.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/subtotal_amount
    - id: tax-amount
      name: tax_amount
      label: Tax Amount
      description: Tax amount.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/tax_amount
    - id: total-amount
      name: total_amount
      label: Total Amount
      description: Total purchase order amount.
      dataType: number
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/total_amount
    - id: buyer-contact-name
      name: buyer_contact_name
      label: Buyer Contact Name
      description: Buyer contact or purchasing agent.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/buyer_contact_name
    - id: approval-status
      name: approval_status
      label: Approval Status
      description: Approved, pending, revised, closed, cancelled, or other status.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/approval_status
  validationRules:
    - id: purchase-order-number-present
      severity: error
      description: purchase_order_number is required for Purchase Order extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: purchase_order_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: purchase_order_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: purchase_order_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(purchase_order_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: po-date-present
      severity: error
      description: po_date is required for Purchase Order extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: po_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: po_date
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: po_date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(po_date)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: buyer-name-present
      severity: error
      description: buyer_name is required for Purchase Order extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: buyer_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: buyer_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: buyer_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(buyer_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: supplier-name-present
      severity: error
      description: supplier_name is required for Purchase Order extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: supplier_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: supplier_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: supplier_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(supplier_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: line-items-present
      severity: error
      description: line_items is required for Purchase Order extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: line_items
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: line_items
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: line_items IS NOT NULL AND JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(line_items) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: total-amount-present
      severity: error
      description: total_amount is required for Purchase Order extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: total_amount
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: total_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: total_amount IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(total_amount)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: subtotal-amount-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: subtotal_amount should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: subtotal_amount
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: subtotal_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: subtotal_amount IS NULL OR subtotal_amount >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: tax-amount-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: tax_amount should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: tax_amount
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: tax_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: tax_amount IS NULL OR tax_amount >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: total-amount-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: total_amount should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: total_amount
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: total_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: total_amount IS NULL OR total_amount >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      purchase_order_number:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Purchase Order workflow.
      supplier_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Purchase Order workflow.
      line_items:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Purchase Order workflow.
      total_amount:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Purchase Order workflow.
      po_date:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Required field for Purchase order extraction.
      buyer_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Required field for Purchase order extraction.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Purchase Order documents combine manufacturing, quality, supplier, material, and operational
      control context.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      purchase_order_number:
        type: string
        description: Purchase order number.
      po_date:
        type: date
        description: Date the purchase order was issued.
        format: date
      buyer_name:
        type: string
        description: Buying legal entity or plant.
      supplier_name:
        type: string
        description: Supplier or vendor name.
      ship_to_location:
        type: string
        description: Ship-to plant, warehouse, or address.
      requested_delivery_date:
        type: date
        description: Requested delivery date.
        format: date
      currency:
        type: string
        description: Currency code.
      payment_terms:
        type: string
        description: Payment terms.
      incoterms:
        type: string
        description: Incoterms or freight terms.
      line_items:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            line_number:
              type: string
              description: Purchase order line number.
            part_number:
              type: string
              description: Part, SKU, item, or material number.
            description:
              type: string
              description: Line item description.
            quantity:
              type: number
              description: Ordered quantity.
            unit:
              type: string
              description: Unit of measure.
            unit_price:
              type: number
              description: Unit price.
            extended_amount:
              type: number
              description: Line extended amount.
            due_date:
              type: date
              description: Line requested or promised due date.
              format: date
        description: PO line items with part, description, quantity, unit price, and due date.
      subtotal_amount:
        type: number
        description: Subtotal amount.
      tax_amount:
        type: number
        description: Tax amount.
      total_amount:
        type: number
        description: Total purchase order amount.
      buyer_contact_name:
        type: string
        description: Buyer contact or purchasing agent.
      approval_status:
        type: string
        description: Approved, pending, revised, closed, cancelled, or other status.
    required:
      - purchase_order_number
      - po_date
      - buyer_name
      - supplier_name
      - line_items
      - total_amount
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: procurement_supply_chain
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - purchase_order_number
          - po_date
          - buyer_name
          - supplier_name
          - line_items
          - total_amount
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - financials
          - line_items
          - parties
          - property_or_asset
          - risk_and_compliance
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields:
          - line_items
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
